title: Trump's FDA pick Overton good for psychedelics, new pain meds but bad for vaccines: Analysts
snippet: If confirmed by the Senate, Heidi Overton—officially revealed Wednesday as President Donald Trump’s choice for FDA commissioner—is expected to be a boon for developers of psychedelic therapeutics and non-opioid pain drugs, but could tow the party line on vaccines.
